11Rules check (c04) · seven questions

Owner (2026-11-25), after the Exercise detail rulings: “Sounds good. Let’s move on.” Program summary checked against every README rule and the rulings from Exercise turns 50–52. In every mock the fields in question have a blue outline; nothing else differs between a question’s options.

Passing: header (H1, back button row, 17/700 small title, 28/800 large title), content at 128pt, section labels 8pt above their cards, no cards stacked directly on each other, cards (gradient, 10 radius), 11px minimum, colours (moss for gains, grey for Same and drops, no red), copy (middots; the date range uses an en dash, not an em dash), Show 2 more expanding in place, every estimated 1RM gain shown. Fixed, following a rule: a few numbers weren’t tabular (the date range, “Estimated 1RM”, “Show 2 more”); the whole content now uses tabular numerals, as on Exercise detail.

Question 1 · section label colour

Look at: the seven section labels (Main lifts, Personal records, Cardio, Recovery, Protocols, Adherence, Body part balance).

They are #8F9098, the secondary grey; every other screen’s section labels are #7C7E86, the README’s eyebrow grey. Claude’s pick: r1b.

r1a#8F9098, as todayRejected · r1b locked

One step lighter than everywhere else.

r1b#7C7E86, the eyebrow greyLocked

Matches every other screen.

Question 2 · the note at the right of a section label

Look at: Start → end, By block, Sessions done, Working sets.

Here they are sentence case 11/600. On Exercise detail the same spot reads “EST. 1RM” and on the Workout tab “ABOUT 12 MIN”: uppercase 11/700 +0.6, like the label itself. Session detail’s edit mode has a sentence-case hint there (“Swipe a set to delete”), so the app is mixed. Counts (Personal records’ 9) are plain numbers either way. Claude’s pick: r2b.

r2aSentence case, as todayRejected · r2b locked

r2bUppercase, like Exercise detail and the Workout tabLocked

Question 3 · the Recovery averages

Look at: 71%, 82% and 11.4 in the Recovery card.

They are 20/800, a size the type scale doesn’t have. The nearest named size is the Readout, 24/800, a graph card’s number on Exercise detail. Claude’s pick: r3b.

r3a20/800, as today, added to the scaleRejected · r3b locked

r3b24/800, the Readout sizeLocked

Same size as Exercise detail’s graph number.

Question 4 · the numbers in the top card

Look at: 95%, 9 and 24 (Adherence, PRs, Best streak).

They are 15/600. The scale’s 15px number is Record value, 15/700 (record weights, Best, the right-hand number on Sessions rows). Claude’s pick: r4b.

r4a15/600, as today, added to the scaleRejected · r4b locked

r4b15/700, the Record value styleLocked

Weight only; the size stays.

Question 5 · body part names under each group

Look at: Quads, Glutes, Hamstrings, Calves, Lats, Upper back and the rest of the indented rows.

They are 13/500 in #A4A5AC, the chart bars’ grey, which isn’t one of the text greys; 13/500 isn’t on the scale either (Value is 13/600). Claude’s pick: r5c.

r5a#A4A5AC 13/500, as todayRejected · r5c locked

r5b#8F9098, the secondary grey; 13/500 staysRejected · r5c locked

r5c#8F9098 at 13/600, the Value styleLocked

Fully on the scale.

Question 6 · Show 2 more

Look at: the Show 2 more control at the foot of Personal records.

It is a tonal button, 14/600 white. Exercise detail’s cards end in a Show all row: centred 13/600 #8F9098, 44pt, a hairline above (README: “the same on every card”). Claude’s pick: r6b.

r6aTonal button, as todayRejected · r6b locked

r6bA Show all row: 13/600 grey, 44pt, hairline aboveLocked

Same as Exercise detail’s Rep records and Sessions.

Question 7 · 12px dates and strain numbers

Look at: Oct 17, Oct 13, Oct 2 on the Rep records rows (also the strain numbers 10.8, 11.6, 12.1 in the Recovery chart).

They are 12/600, which Exercise detail also uses for row dates and meta; the scale only names Helper, 12/500. The difference is slight. Claude’s pick: r7a.

Exercise detail stays as it is too.

r7b12/500, the Helper weightLocked

All seven built (gen_rules11.py) in the Program Summary Demo and the whole-app demo; r7b also on Exercise detail (main, accessory and long-name demos): every 12px text there is 12/500 now. 1Program summary · what it leads with

The page the program complete card on Home opens (13f; turn 14 moved biggest gains and the other detail here). Built on the APEX Design System: two hues, the biggest number wins, facts not verdicts, moss and a glow only on earned surfaces. Pushed screen: glass back, the program’s name as the centered 20/800 title, tab bar on Home.

Mock program: Pillars, 11 weeks, Aug 3 – Oct 18, 52 of 55 sessions, 14 PRs. The three phones answer the open questions three ways: what leads (sessions, strength, phases), how celebratory the page is, and whether it offers the next step. Scroll each phone.
